name: claudetto
description: Lists the claudetto plugin and its optional browser and docs plugins.

plugins.name: claudetto
plugins.description: Adds a lean output style, a main agent with a roster of six agents, a permission gate that answers each permission prompt, a status line command with the plan usage, and the `setup` skill. Adds the MiniSpec skills `propose`, `apply`, `verify`, `archive`, `explore`, `update`, and `sync`, a handover to a fresh session in place of the compaction summary, a `goal` check and a check of each ticked task, a ledger of edited files, and a cleanup at session start. With a key, Jev answers `AskUserQuestion`, the asks of the gate, and the handover offer.

plugins.name: claudetto-browser
plugins.description: Drives a real browser with `agent-browser` for pages that need JavaScript, a login, or clicks, and for checks of a UI change. `WebFetch` and `WebSearch` stay the tools for reading and search, because they cost fewer tokens.

plugins.name: claudetto-docs
plugins.description: Gets current library and API docs from the Context7 MCP server, or with the Context7 CLI `ctx7`. Works with no key, and keeps an optional key in secure storage.
